alert_semantics.fallen: internal state only; it does not independently fire the existing alert

startup.already_fallen: initialize internal fallen state without emitting an alert

track_lifecycle.eviction: remove state after stale track TTL
track_lifecycle.generation: monotonically increments on reconnect after eviction
track_lifecycle.reconnect: new generation resets temporal and dedup state
track_lifecycle.reuse: same track_id after eviction is distinct by generation
